description: This file is a TypeScript module that exports types and functions related to MCP tools, session management, and runtime creation for a project involving 'pi-bundle' components.

methods.name: createSessionMcpRuntime
methods.description: Creates a new MCP session runtime.

methods.name: disposeAllSessionMcpRuntimes
methods.description: Disposes all active MCP session runtimes.

methods.name: disposeSessionMcpRuntime
methods.description: Disposes a specific MCP session runtime.

methods.name: getOrCreateSessionMcpRuntime
methods.description: Retrieves an existing or creates a new MCP session runtime.

methods.name: getSessionMcpRuntimeManager
methods.description: Returns the manager for MCP session runtimes.

methods.name: createBundleMcpToolRuntime
methods.description: Creates a bundle MCP tool runtime.

methods.name: materializeBundleMcpToolsForRun
methods.description: Materializes MCP tools for a specific run.
